params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Cho'Gath}} kills an enemy, it {{tip|heal|heals}} and restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Cho'Gath''' kills an enemy, it {{tip|heals}} for {{pplevel|18 to 52|color=heal}} and restores {{as|{{sti|mana|{{pplevel|4.72 to 9.48}} mana}}}}.
params.notes:
* ''Carnivore'' will also trigger when '''Cho'Gath''' destroys a {{tip|turret}}, but not from other structures.
* ''Carnivore'' does not trigger upon destroying {{tip|wards}} and possibly other similar units.
** It does trigger upon killing one of {{cai|Prophet of an Elder God|Illaoi|Tentacles}}. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=161&v=_65aFxwtPfw]

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cho'Gath}} ruptures the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies within, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them upon landing.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' ruptures the target location after a {{rutngt|0.625}} delay, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for 1 second, and afterwards {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 60% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* The delay before the rupture does not include the cast time.
* The animation is visible in {{tip|brush}} and in [[Sight|fog of war]].
* {{tip|Cleanse|Cleansing}} the {{tip|airborne}} will not prevent the {{tip|slow}}.
** The slow itself can also not be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, but will always be prevented if the airborne was.
* The area will still rupture even if '''Cho'Gath''' dies during the delay.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cho'Gath}} roars in a cone, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silencing}} enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' roars in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: Enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{ui|Rift Scuttler|Rift Scuttlers}} hit are also {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.
params.target range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|650|center-to-edge (from caster's center to target's edge)}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Cho'Gath}} next few basic attacks launch forth deadly spikes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit based on ''{{ai|Feast|Cho'Gath}}'' stacks and each {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' empowers its next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 6 seconds to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and launch a blast of spikes {{tip|on-attack}} in the target's direction. Enemies struck are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The damage is modified against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: The width of the blast of spikes increases based on '''Cho'Gath's''' character {{tip|size}} modifier when they launch, including but not limited to the bonus from ''{{ai|Feast|Cho'Gath|Feast}}'' stacks.
params.description3: ''Vorpal Spikes {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Cho'Gath's''' basic attack timer.''
params.range: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|650|From an offset 25 units in front of Cho'Gath}}
params.width: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{pp|type=bonus size|key1=%|340;370;380;410;440;470;500|0;16.5±1.5;35±2;56.5±1.5;72.5±2.5;95±1;95.5±0.5|formula=340 +30 width at every bonus size threshold except +10 for the second instead, likely a bug}}
params.notes:
* The missiles are launched from an offset 25 units in front of Cho'Gath and towards the target's location on-attack-complete.
** When attacking enemies within 25 units center-to-center of '''Cho'Gath''', the missile will fire in the opposite direction.
* '''Cho'Gath's''' size factors into the wideness of the hitbox ''Vorpal Spikes'' has. External size modifiers ({{ai|Wild Growth|Lulu}}) contribute to this.
** At certain size thresholds, the missile gets replaced by a different one with a different width. At each step, the width grows by 30, except for the 3rd missile, where it only grows by 10.{{bug|2}}
** Some of the size thresholds are placed very weird.{{bug|2}}
** The missile range is unchanged.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not apply its effects against [[structures]].

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cho'Gath}} devours an enemy, dealing {{as|true damage}} based on {{as|'''Cho'Gath's bonus''' health}}. If this attack kills the target, '''Cho'Gath''' gains a permanent ''Feast'' {{tip|stack}} that infinitely stacks.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Feast:}} For each stack, '''Cho'Gath''' gains {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and increased {{tip|size}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' attempts to eat the target enemy, dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. Against non-{{tip|champions}}, the '''base''' damage is modified.
params.leveling:
{{st|Champion True Damage|{{ap|300|475|650}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Non-Champion True Damage|1200 {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description2: If the target is killed, '''Cho'Gath''' gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Feast''. Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}} or {{tip|minion|minions}}.
params.description3: Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the cast range of the ability by {{fd|2.5}}, for a maximum increase of 25 at 10 stacks, and grants '''Cho'Gath''' {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}} as well as {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and increased {{tip|size}}, capping at {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}} and 100% increased size.
params.notes:
* The increased size stacks additively with other size increases.
* The name of the bonus health buff is ''"Feast"''.
* The bonus attack range and increase size cap at respectively {{ap|75/((60 to 100)/13)|round=2}} and {{ap|100/((60 to 100)/10)|round=2}} stacks, with the last stack being effective as the decimal part of the value (no decimal meaning 100% as effective).
* Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the damage by {{ap|8|12|16}}.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
* If an enemy {{tip|champion}} has health below the amount of {{as|true damage}} ''Feast'' deals, they will be marked for execution. This indicator does not consider {{tip|shield|shields}} or {{tip|invulnerability}}.  
* Consuming any additional {{ui|Voidgrub|Voidgrubs}} from the same spawn group will be tracked as a "monster eaten" for ''Feast's'' buff, but will neither grant any bonuses nor count towards the 6-stack limit.{{bug}}
* While not on {{sti|cooldown}}, ''Feast's'' ability icon on the HUD can be [[ping|pinged]] to announce its damage to {{tip|monsters}} in the ally chat.
